      Perfect little black dress

      January 5, 2026

      I really wanted to snag the white in this dress, but at the time it was sold out so I settled for black. I am so glad I ended up with that color. Normally, I have to size down a size in J.Crew dresses, but I did size up to a size 6 in this one. So beautiful!
